observations.title: Validation checklist should become editable / structured
observations.assignedTarget: WC12 or post-Phase-03 validation UX cleanup
observations.summary: Manual validation checklist should move to the top of the validation record and support structured pass/fail/skipped responses.

observations.title: Screenshot paste and evidence UI needs cleanup
observations.summary: Screenshot paste should be primary; attachment should be fallback; repo-relative paths should clear after image creation; evidence should display as image/card instead of long path text.

observations.title: Multi-project / workspace support does not exist
Top workflow/action bars and Supporting Tools are duplicative and consume workspace real estate
observations.assignedTarget: Later Phase 03 navigation/layout cleanup or post-Phase-03 UI consolidation
observations.summary: Action bar remains duplicative and cluttered; Supporting Tools duplicates action-bar behavior; top navigation should become collapsible/minimizable or otherwise return workspace real estate.

observations.title: Report review protocol and validation disposition role confusion
observations.assignedTarget: WC08-REPAIR02 — Report Review Protocol and Validation Disposition Governance
observations.summary: Validation reports and Implementer Reports lack embedded Architect review instructions. Operator Decision creates role confusion by asking the Operator to make workflow disposition decisions that should be made by the Architect after analysis.
